## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 23, 2026 - May 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Appreviewer8718_, May 29, 2026, 1/5: "Ok, just a few things, you have to pay for basically everything, some of the characters are… not even what they should look like, the app is buggy, your ‘deals’ are hyper expensive, and maybe make it so it does one long chat instead of, oh idk four unless it’s four people in the story please and thank you"
            2. _deathslayerxl65_, May 23, 2026, 3/5: "I enjoyed it for a short while but I don’t think it’s great on a long term basis. The AI is great at getting into the characters you set out for it and it’s cool there are a week characters from popular anime to chosise from. Even with the memory on higher settings, I found it still routinely forgot about things pretty quickly. I found in conversations it would always just default back to what you have in your bio page for likes and favorite anime. For example no matter how many times we role played have a movie marathon of my favorite anime it would still say a few conversations later it’s never watched it before. And I think that’s where it lost me. It was fun for a short time but the conversations are just missing something and I lost interest. The app is also terrible buggy. Conversations getting cut off, issues with messages not sending, a lot of bugs. Overall AI gets an 8/10 from me and the app itself gets a 2/10."
